Vijay and Ganga live happily with Vijay's brother Sharad. When it is revealed that Sharad's wife Poonam cannot conceive, Ganga makes the ultimate sacrifice and gives Poonam her own child.
Movie:- Aadmi Khilona Hai (1993) | aadmi khilauna hai
Starcast:- Jeetendra, Govinda, Meenakshi Sheshadri, Reena Roy, Laxmikant Berde
Directed by:- J. Om Prakash
Produced by:- Padma Rani
Music by:- Nadeem-Shravan
